relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Galcanezumab yielded the most significant reduction (MDD: − 2.363; 95% CI: − 3.043 to − 1.683)

relationships.subject: erenumab
relationships.evidence_quote: erenumab and naproxen had significant decreases with MDDs of − 2.100

relationships.subject: sumatriptan
relationships.evidence_quote: SUCRA analysis revealed that sumatriptan was the most effective acute treatment for pain relief at both 2 h and 24 h.

relationships.subject: frovatriptan
relationships.evidence_quote: frovatriptan has been demonstrated to be the most effective preventive treatment for MM among all triptans available

key_findings: Meta-analysis of 26 RCTs: sumatriptan and lasmiditan best for acute MM; frovatriptan best preventive triptan; galcanezumab and erenumab reduce headache days most.
